criteria.text: Patient must have undergone and failed a minimum 6 months of intensive non-operative treatment including medication optimization, activity modification, and active physical therapy.
criteria.source_quote: Have undergone and failed a minimum 6 months of intensive non-operative treatment that must include medication optimization, activity modification, and active physical therapy
criteria.if_missing: Did the patient undergo and fail at least 6 months of intensive non-operative treatment including medication optimization, activity modification, and active physical therapy?
Is the patient's pain documented as non-radiating?
criteria.short: Pain is radiating or not documented as non-radiating

criteria.if_missing: Is the patient's pain documented as unilateral?
criteria.short: Pain is not documented as unilateral

criteria.text: Pain must be caudal to the lumbar spine (L5), localized over the posterior SIJ, and consistent with SIJ pain.
criteria.source_quote: caudal to the lumbar spine (L5 vertebrae), localized over the posterior SIJ, and consistent with SIJ pain
criteria.if_missing: Is the pain localized caudal to L5, over the posterior SIJ, and consistent with SIJ pain?
criteria.short: Pain location not consistent with SIJ pain criteria

criteria.text: Patient must have localized tenderness with palpation of the posterior SIJ, without similar tenderness elsewhere and without other obvious pain sources.
criteria.source_quote: Localized tenderness with palpation of the posterior SIJ in the absence of tenderness of similar severity elsewhere ... and other obvious sources for their pain do not exist
criteria.if_missing: Is there localized tenderness at the posterior SIJ with no similar tenderness elsewhere and no other obvious pain source?
criteria.short: Tenderness pattern does not meet SIJ-specific criteria

criteria.text: Patient must have a positive response to the thigh thrust test OR the compression test.
criteria.source_quote: Positive response to the thigh thrust test OR compression test
criteria.if_missing: Did the patient have a positive thigh thrust test or compression test?
criteria.short: No positive thigh thrust or compression test documented

criteria.text: Patient must have positive results on at least 2 of the following additional provocative tests: Gaenslen's test, Distraction test, Patrick's sign.
criteria.source_quote: AND 2 of the following additional provocative tests: Gaenslen's test, Distraction test, Patrick's sign
criteria.if_missing: How many of Gaenslen's test, Distraction test, and Patrick's sign were positive?
criteria.short: Fewer than 2 additional provocative tests positive

criteria.text: Patient must not have generalized pain behavior (e.g., somatoform disorder) or generalized pain disorders (e.g., fibromyalgia).
criteria.source_quote: Absence of generalized pain behavior (e.g. somatoform disorder) or generalized pain disorders (e.g. fibromyalgia)
criteria.if_missing: Does the patient have a generalized pain behavior or disorder such as somatoform disorder or fibromyalgia?

criteria.text: Imaging of the SI joint (plain radiographs and CT or MRI) must exclude destructive lesions or inflammatory arthropathy.
criteria.source_quote: Imaging (plain radiographs and a CT or MRI) of the SI joint that excludes the presence of destructive lesions (e.g. tumor, infection) or inflammatory arthropathy
criteria.if_missing: Do SI joint imaging studies (plain films and CT or MRI) exclude destructive lesions or inflammatory arthropathy?
criteria.short: SI joint imaging does not exclude destructive/inflammatory findings

criteria.text: Imaging of the ipsilateral hip (plain radiographs) must rule out osteoarthritis.
criteria.source_quote: Imaging of the ipsilateral hip (plain radiographs) to rule out osteoarthritis
criteria.if_missing: Does ipsilateral hip radiograph rule out osteoarthritis?
criteria.short: Hip imaging does not rule out osteoarthritis

criteria.text: Imaging of the lumbar spine (CT or MRI) must rule out neural compression or other degenerative condition causing the pain.
criteria.source_quote: Imaging of the lumbar spine (CT or MRI) to rule out neural compression or other degenerative condition that can be causing low back or buttock pain
criteria.if_missing: Does lumbar spine CT or MRI rule out neural compression or other degenerative cause of the pain?
criteria.short: Lumbar imaging does not rule out other causes

criteria.text: Patient must have at least 75% reduction of pain for the expected duration of anesthetic following an image-guided, contrast-enhanced SIJ injection, on 2 separate occasions.
criteria.source_quote: At least 75% reduction of pain for the expected duration of the anesthetic used following an image-guided, contrast-enhanced SIJ injection on 2 separate occasions
criteria.if_missing: Did the patient have at least 75% pain reduction for the expected anesthetic duration after image-guided contrast-enhanced SIJ injections on 2 separate occasions?
criteria.short: Diagnostic SIJ injection response criterion not met

criteria.text: Procedure is not indicated if patient has systemic arthropathy such as ankylosing spondylitis or rheumatoid arthritis.
criteria.source_quote: Systemic arthropathy such as ankylosing spondylitis or rheumatoid arthritis
criteria.if_missing: Does the patient have a systemic arthropathy such as ankylosing spondylitis or rheumatoid arthritis?

criteria.text: Procedure is not indicated in the presence of infection, tumor, or fracture.
criteria.if_missing: Is there evidence of infection, tumor, or fracture at the SIJ?

criteria.text: Procedure is not indicated in the presence of acute, traumatic instability of the SIJ.
criteria.source_quote: Acute, traumatic instability of the SIJ
criteria.if_missing: Is there acute, traumatic instability of the SIJ?

criteria.text: Procedure is not indicated if there is neural compression on MRI or CT that correlates with the patient's symptoms or another more likely pain source.
criteria.source_quote: Neural compression as seen on an MRI or CT that correlates with the patient's symptoms or other more likely source for their pain
criteria.if_missing: Is there neural compression on MRI/CT correlating with symptoms, or another more likely pain source identified?
criteria.short: Correlating neural compression or other likely cause present
